_comment: Lovish's Wager Book (design: hero-abilities-overhaul, 'First prototype: the Wager Book'). The keyword parser's whole understanding: no language model. Each intent lists its keywords (whole words; a keyword of 4+ letters also matches longer words that start with it, so 'rain' takes 'raining'; a phrase with a space matches as a phrase and counts once per word in it, so 'run away' beats 'run'). The intent with the most matches wins; a tie goes to the smaller 'size' (the smaller ask). No match is 'nonsense'. 'size_up' words raise the asked tier by one each (at most two), 'size_down' words lower it by one; a number of 10 or more raises it by one. 'base' is the agree chance before level and size (WagerVerdict). Read once from the jar when first needed (prototype): /reload and datapack overrides do not reach it yet; edit it in the source and rebuild. Edit freely: the GameTest wager_parser_maps_every_intent names one sample line per intent.
